title: College travel (mid-level)
question:
The chart below shows how students travelled to Northfield College in 2005 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
essay:
The bar chart show how students go to Northfield College in 2005 and 2025.

In 2005 the car was the most popular with 38% of students. Bus was 27% and walking was 18%. Bicycle and train was very low, only 9% and 8%.

In 2025 car went down to 22%. Bus become the most popular with 30%. Bicycle increased very much to 26%, and train also increase to 12%. Walking go down a little to 15%.

I think this happened because petrol is very expensive and the college made a new bus station. Also young people now like to do exercise so they ride bicycle.

In conclusion, car was popular in 2005 but in 2025 students use more bus and bicycle.
